audit.recode_to: No category change (keep TONAL-OR-PITCH-ACCENT, lexical/mobile place, no secondary stress). Rewrite prule from Ivšić 1936 pp. 67-73: most Kajkavian dialects have a three-way accent system (short ȁ, long falling ȃ, neo-acute/long rising ã) with distinctive pitch and quantity, accent place lexically specified and paradigmatically mobile; sub-dialects differ by accent retraction/advancement (metataxis) and tone reversal (metatony), Virje-type Podravina dialects restrict the accent to the last two syllables; Rožić's Štokavian-style four-accent description applies only to the Prigorje border variety. Add caution that urban Zagreb Kajkavian is reported stress-only (Magner 1966, not yet read).
audit.reasoning: (1) Quote check: the deciding quotation and domain quote are verbatim in the held archive.org scanned of Rožić 1893-94 at the stated section (Rad 115 pp. 97-98; noun passages pp. 108-109). (2) Deciding source: a 192-pp. 1893-94 dialect monograph of a single border sub-dialect, analysed through the Štokavian four-accent template; Ivšić 1936 (fetched sources now from HAZU DiZbi, open) re-quotes this exact passage and judges Rožić's short-accent notation confused, while stating that Kajkavian proper has three distinctive accents (ȁ ȃ ã) with free, paradigmatically mobile place and no Štokavian rising accents. That confirms the catalog category (pitch-accent, lexical placement, no positional/weight rule, WORD domain) but shows the prule text over-generalises Rožić's Štokavian-style system to the languoid. (3) Better sources exist and are not held: Lončarić 1996 (standard monograph, print), Houtzagers 19

sources.quote: p. 67: 'Kajkavski dijalekat, osim u najbližem susjedstvu sa štokavskim, ne poznaje štokavskih akcenata [` ´] pa se u njemu primjeri kao lopata i vezati izgovaraju lȍpata i vȇzati; primjeri kao selo i vino u starijim govorima čuvaju stari akcenat selȍ i vinȍ, a u mlađima se akcenat prenosi …'. p. 68 (on Rožić): 'Takvih primjera jednih od drugih nije Rožić često ni u paradigmama odvajao, te je zato u njima velika zbrka'. p. 70: 'Mnogi kajkavski govori čuvaju još staru hrvatskosrpsku akcentuaciju sa 3 osnovna prahrvatskosrpska akcenta ȁ ȃ ã … Akcenat ȃ odgovara praslavenskom (meso) i metatonijsko
